topic: Ionic and Covalent Structures, Properties, and Conductivity
key_concepts: Ionic crystals such as NaCl have ions at lattice points.
Molecular crystals such as water and sucrose have molecules at lattice points.
Ionic bonds hold Na+ and Cl- ions together in NaCl.
Covalent bonds hold atoms within water and sugar molecules.
Weak intermolecular forces hold separate water or sugar molecules together.
NaCl dissolves in water and releases ions.
Sugar dissolves in water as intact molecules without breaking covalent bonds.
Salt solution conducts electricity because mobile ions carry charge.
Sugar solution and distilled water do not conduct electricity because they lack ions.
Tap water conducts electricity due to dissolved ions.
